intro: Material movers build coordination, monitoring and time management skills that production, rail and trade jobs reward. Of the 25 careers below, Packaging and Filling Machine Operators match best at 83%, and 20 of the 25 pay more than the $40,240 median.
why_it_works: Moving freight means working in sync with a crew, watching equipment and hitting tight loading schedules. O*NET rates coordination at 3 out of 5 for laborers and material movers, so machine operation, rail and production roles rank high. Many of these jobs replace some heavy lifting with running or monitoring machines. Rail and trade roles pay much more for the same reliability and safety habits. The skills to add are problem solving, quality control and judgment.
tips: Ask to train on a forklift, conveyor or packaging line where you work, since machine skills open most of these matches.
Look at railroad and construction trade openings, which pay far more and often train on the job or through apprenticeships.
Keep a clean safety record and mention it, because nearly every match cares about it.

faq.q: What jobs can warehouse and freight workers do next?
faq.a: The closest matches are Packaging and Filling Machine Operators and Tenders (83%), Helpers--Production Workers (79%) and Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders (78%), based on O*NET 31.0. Railroad Brake, Signal, and Switch Operators (77%) is a higher-paying option.

faq.q: Which jobs pay more than material moving?
faq.a: 20 of the 25 matches pay more than the $40,240 median for laborers and material movers. Railroad Brake, Signal, and Switch Operators and Locomotive Firers earn $68,840 (+71%), Tapers earn $68,270 (+70%) and Postal Service Mail Sorters earn $58,470 (+45%), according to BLS May 2025 data.

faq.q: Do I need a degree to move up from warehouse work?
faq.a: No. All 25 matches usually need no more education than a material mover job, based on O*NET Job Zones. Training happens on the job, and 80% of workers in the closest match have a high school diploma or the equivalent.

faq.q: What warehouse jobs are similar to freight and stock moving?
faq.a: In the same field, the nearest roles are Industrial Truck and Tractor Operators (84% match), Packers and Packagers, Hand (84%) and Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders (83%). Forklift work is a natural next step, since it adds equipment skills to what you already do.
